title: Schedule of Term, Renewal and Termination Figures — Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
These are the term, renewal and termination figures of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement for each tier.

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum initial term (months) | 12 | 12 | 24 | 24 | 36 | 36 |
| Length of each automatic renewal (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Calendar days of written notice required to terminate | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 90 | 90 |
| Early termination fee: months of platform fee, at most the months remaining in the term, billed when the program terminates before the end of its term | 0 | 0 | 3 | 3 | 6 | 6 |
| Business days after the termination date within which the final deduction file is settled | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Explanatory notes

- The notice period is counted in calendar days; the settlement of the final deduction file in business days (Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays).
- On the Paystride Program Starter and Growth tiers the early termination fee figure is 0 months.
